title: La protesta dei camici bianchi / White Coats Protest (announced Ticino healthcare-worker action)
reason: The reports describe a distributed display of white coats from medical-office windows and a one-minute hospital work abstention, not an assembled public gathering of at least 50 people. No participant count or public gathering is documented, and the announced action's execution is not independently verified.
notes: Potential healthcare-worker collective action targeting cantonal/federal pandemic policy is retained as an exclusion lead. A work stoppage or symbolic display does not establish public-assembly attendance.
